name: Photo Filters
description: Twelve filters like Vintage, Noir and Dream plus sliders for brightness, warmth, vignette and grain. Hold the photo to compare with the original.
prompt: A photo filter app: open or take a photo, pick from twelve filters with live thumbnails, fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, vignette and grain, hold to compare and save the result.
author: gonzaroman
